intro: A severed, bony digit scavenged from the walking dead prowling the cursed groves and cemeteries of Duskwood. Madame Eva of Darkshire collects these macabre remnants alongside ghoul fangs and spider venom to craft protective talismans.

p: The cursed woods of Duskwood are overrun by the restless remains of the dead, ranging from skeletal raiders and warriors to necrotic mages and fiends. While ordinary travelers avoid touching the foul remains of the risen dead, fortune tellers and mystics value their cold essence. Madame Eva, the resident seer of Darkshire, gathers these bony fingers to bind their lingering necrotic energies into a ward of retaliatory magic known as the Totem of Infliction.
